agency: California Highway Patrol and Bakersfield Police Department
area: South H Street to South Union Avenue area, Bakersfield
disposition: driver crashed into the median and ran; air unit tracked him through yards; search continued
summary: A chase that began with a silver sedan reported at about 80 mph on southbound Highway 99 ran onto city streets just after midnight. The driver turned south on South H Street, went east on McKee Road and hit a dead end just east of Highway 99, made a U-turn, then crashed into the median on South Union Avenue near the 7500 block. The driver ran west along a fence line into a residential block near Acoma Way, and a sheriff's air unit followed him over backyards near Lazy River Drive before losing sight of him behind a home. Officers set a perimeter and worked through the yards.

area: Pioneer Drive and Fairfax Road area, Oildale
disposition: occupants bailed out; three detained, one outstanding
summary: A traffic stop on westbound Niles Street turned into a chase when a vehicle reported to be carrying at least five people took off. The car ran east on Pioneer Drive through a red light at Fairfax Road, turned north on Meadows, and ended near the 4900 block of Pioneer Drive, where the occupants jumped a fence and ran. Officers detained three people and reported one still outstanding.

disposition: man reported throwing knives and striking a relative with a bat; heavy response
summary: Officers were sent to an apartment on the 3900 block of Oregon Street after a caller reported her brother was having a mental breakdown, was throwing knives around, and had hit another relative with a baseball bat. A verbal argument could be heard in the background when dispatchers took the call, and the call drew a heavy police and fire response.

disposition: victim reported stab wounds to the arm; suspect vehicle described
summary: Deputies were sent to the Linda Vista area of Oildale for a stabbing call. The caller reported a man had stab wounds to his arm and that the man's girlfriend was with him, and a suspect was reported leaving in a white Chevrolet Silverado. Deputies worked to confirm the location of the reporting party and the pickup.

agency: Bakersfield Police Department and Kern County Sheriff's Office
disposition: several children reported missing and located; extra units kept on the grounds
summary: A carnival drew a run of missing-child calls through the evening. A 3-year-old girl in a Dodgers jersey was reported missing and then found at the main gate, a 9-year-old boy was reported missing for about 15 minutes before he was located, a 2-year-old was reported missing before being found, and an 8-year-old girl was reported missing later in the night. Officers also handled a fight between two groups of women at the Ferris wheel and two people were taken into custody after a disturbance at the gate.

area: South Harris Road and Spring Creek Loop area, Bakersfield
disposition: handgun reported; description broadcast to units
summary: Deputies were sent after a woman reported that a handgun was pointed at her during a road rage incident near South Harris Road and Spring Creek Loop. A description of the woman and the firearm went out to units.

area: Playfair Road and Ashe Road area, Bakersfield
disposition: several vehicles reported burning; crews responded
summary: Fire crews were sent to the Playfair Road and Ashe Road area for a report of multiple vehicles burning.

disposition: structure fire assignment dispatched
summary: Fire crews were dispatched on a report of a structure fire shortly after 12:20 a.m. in the Bakersfield area.

disposition: quarter-acre grass fire; crews on scene
summary: Fire crews on scene reported a quarter-acre grass fire in the Copas Road area and assigned a unit to take the west side of the fire.

disposition: van and semi involved; both on the shoulder
summary: A white van and a semi were involved in a crash when the semi rear-ended the van, which then came to rest on the right-hand shoulder of the southbound side. Units were working to sort out the vehicles and injuries.

disposition: ShotSpotter activation; officers sent
summary: A ShotSpotter activation reported one round fired in the Oregon Street area, and officers were sent to check.

area: Cal City Boulevard east of the railroad tracks, California City
disposition: single vehicle; one patient conscious and breathing
summary: A single-vehicle crash was reported on Cal City Boulevard about two miles east of the railroad tracks. One patient was reported conscious and breathing, and the CHP and city police were handling the call.

disposition: taser deployed; air unit searched a shed and yards
summary: Deputies working a call in northwest Bakersfield deployed a taser on a suspect, and an air unit searched backyards, a shed with an open door, and a property with heavy tree cover after a person was reported moving between homes.

area: Edison Highway and Comanche Drive, Bakersfield
disposition: car fire reported; crews responded
summary: Crews were sent to the southwest intersection of Edison Highway and Comanche Drive for a reported car fire.

disposition: man reported attempting a theft; employees and security involved
summary: Officers were sent to a store in the Chester Avenue area after employees and security reported a man attempted to take merchandise and got into a disturbance with staff before leaving.

disposition: two people described; units sent to the north entrance
summary: Officers were sent to Valley Plaza after two people were reported at the north entrance near the front of a department store, arriving in a white pickup.

disposition: caller reported a person in the front of a residence; units sent
summary: A caller reported seeing a nude man in front of a residence on the 5400 block of Pembroke Avenue and captured him on video surveillance. Officers were sent.

disposition: pickup reported northbound; units advised
summary: A caller reported a pickup driving the wrong way northbound from the Wheeler Ridge area. Units were advised.

disposition: verbal disturbance reported; units sent
summary: Officers were sent to the 600 block of Woodrow Avenue for a verbal disturbance where someone reported being hit near the rear of the property.

disposition: medical aid requested; translator needed
summary: Crews were sent to the 3600 block of Grissom Street for a medical aid call, and crews were working through a translator.

agency: Kern County fire and medical crews
disposition: medical aid at the main entrance
summary: A crew was sent to the main entrance of the Hard Rock Casino for a medical aid call.

area: 6100 block of Star Sapphire Drive, Bakersfield
disposition: fire alarm at a residence
summary: A crew was sent to the 6100 block of Star Sapphire Drive for a residential fire alarm.

area: Pinos Way and Johnson Road area, Kern County
disposition: caller reported screaming; units sent
summary: Deputies opened a line after a caller reported at least two women screaming in the Pinos Way and Johnson Road area.

agency: Kern County fire and medical crews
disposition: labor in progress; crew sent
summary: A crew was sent to a parking lot near an apartment complex on Garces Highway in Delano for a report of labor in progress.

area: Highway 99 north of the split, Kern County
disposition: semi reported swerving; units advised
summary: A semi with a white box trailer was reported swerving northbound on Highway 99 north of the split.

area: southbound Interstate 5 north of Highway 43, Kern County
disposition: semi reported swerving; units advised
summary: A semi with a box trailer was reported swerving with near-misses southbound on Interstate 5 north of Highway 43.

area: East Evans and Williams area, Bakersfield
disposition: call cleared; fireworks reported
summary: Officers cleared a fireworks complaint at East Evans and Williams.
